messages.subject: SCRbook request
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I'm a grad student searching for answers.  I was unable to find the SCR group, but I'm hoping to get help with some data from the scrbook package.  I would like to see the code for "jaguarDataCh11", but as far as I can tell, it's not available within the package itself.  If anyone could provide me with some guidance, it would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you,

Melissa

messages.subject: Re: SCRbook request
messages.body_plain:
Hi Melissa,

Here is a link to the SCR list: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/spatialcapturerecapture

We never got around to publishing the analysis of the jaguar data, which is why that dataset isn't included in the R package. However, you could contact Agustin Paviolo to see if he would be willing to share it.

Richard

messages.subject: dynamic occupancy model for Marsh Seedeater
messages.subject_clean: dynamic occupancy model for Marsh Seedeater
messages.body_plain:
Hi Marc and all, last year I asked you advice on assessing habitat variables that affect occupancy of an endangered bird species Marsh Seedeater. I had about 100 sites (points), 20% were presences from the first season. I repeated the survey last december (second season), visiting each point about 3 or 4 times. So the first season I do not have repeated visits, but the second season I do have. In each season I measured 3 habitat variables (e.g. grass heigh, number of trees, seed -food- abundance) that may govern extinction and colonization rates.

So, as I understand, I can estimate occupancy for both seasons, correcting for imperfect detection. Then I should adjust a dynamic occupancy model with covariates that allow me to assess if the change in covariates levels are affecting colonization/extinction rates. Some sites might be correlated, and temporal correlation may also exist so I guess random effects would be good to include in the model.

So the question is if you know a example that I can follow for applying this model, with the code and results interpretation and plotting.

Thank you very much in advanced.

Joaquín.

--
Joaquín Aldabe

Grupo Biodiversidad, Ambiente y Sociedad
Centro Universitario de la Región Este, Universidad de la República
